text: I was really enjoying organizing my day with this app, which is very fun and motivating but this app is supposed to help you with habits yet you can't even add the habits you want due to limitation. You have to pay for it and I think this app failed to do it's purpose. It's so limited it loses it's point. At least you've given me a taste in organizing so I can do it on my own. Thanks.
author: Victoria Avraam

text: It really helps you feel motivated and try to make the little rabbit happy and live in a better environment, It's so cute and 🥺👉👈 I made sure for my rabbit to live in a clean space. doing those habits/tasks became more fun and less than a deed and it helped me with my adhd, wish I could have more slots for habits, I view it as too few because I have many habits to work on, with different kinds of priorities
author: Roza B (Rovi)
